title: Modbus Client Write
text: Write data to Modbus server, 1 input; {Client} selects Modbus client, {Server ID} sets the address of the server, {Registers} sets the list of Modbus and {Block sample time} sets the sample time for write operation. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Reg_ x
ports.summary: Vector of register values double | array of doubles

params.name: Server ID
params.values: Address of the server 1 (default) | nonnegative integer in the range [0, 255]

params.name: Block sample time
params.values: Sample time for write operation -1 (default) | nonnegative scalar
